summary: Export bounded fleet work-state, oldest-work and idle-with-work gauges through daemon OTLP metrics

schema.detail: Uses existing sparse work and activity indexes without migrations.

compatibility.detail: Adds metrics only; no client, peer or harness protocol changes.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: Uses existing OTLP configuration. Fleet dashboards aggregate replicas with max, not sum.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes; existing binary rollback remains unchanged.
